migration.description: Move task operations state and startup backfill checkpoints to a separate maintenance SQLite database.
migration.release_unit_description: Task operations pages and maintenance database rollout.

durable_state.description: Managed task controls, latest progress snapshots, task run history, bounded errors, and migrated legacy task records.
durable_state.storage_implementation: Sibling SQLite file derived from DATABASE_PATH or MAINTENANCE_DATABASE_PATH.

ddl_structural_changes.description: Create managed task, progress, and run tables in the maintenance database.

dml_changes.description: Seed the stable task registry and control defaults idempotently.

historical_data_backfill_or_transformati.description: Copy legacy task run and startup backfill state into maintenance storage with an idempotent compatibility window.

progress_signals: migration marker and copied row counts

required_test_evidence: candidate opens a fresh maintenance database and seeds the stable registry
restarting after a partial copy is idempotent and does not duplicate runs
maintenance database unavailability does not write task observation to the main database
legacy task API remains readable during the compatibility window
